title: FirstTimeGuestFollowUpInput
description: Input schema for first-time guest follow-up sequence generation.

lead_pastor_name.description: Name of the Lead/Senior Pastor (or sender).

visitor_first_name.description: First name of the visitor (never use full names to maintain privacy).

family_status.description: e.g., Attended alone, attended with spouse, attended with children in kids ministry.

stated_interests.description: Interests checked on connection card (e.g., Small Groups, Serving, Kids Ministry, Just Exploring).

upcoming_event.description: Next event or upcoming sermon series (e.g., Newcomers Pizza Lunch next Sunday at 12:30 PM).

website_or_contact_link.description: Church website or pastor contact link.
